title: Special Topics in National/International Cinemas; Making Modern China Through Media
description:
Cross-listed with CHIN418O. Credit only granted for CHIN418O or CINE429O.

How have media shaped the making of modern China? This course traces the history of the People s Republic through transformations in media, from posters, photography, radio, film, and television to video games, digital platforms, surveillance technologies, and AI. Moving from the socialist period through the reform era to the present, students will explore how media have transformed everyday life, political participation, labor, memory, and identity, shaping how people see the world and imagine what it means to be modern.
